Download a single language parser and verify count

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::download;

fn main() {
    let names_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"["python"]"#).unwrap();
    let names = serde_json::from_value::<Vec<String>>(names_json).unwrap();
    let names_refs: Vec<&str> = names.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
    let result = download(&names_refs);
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
